name: にちか
text: ────タタタン、タタタタ……ですよね
trans:
—Tatatan, tatatata...
That's how it goes, right?

name: 美琴
text:
うん
踏み替えの解釈が少し違うかもしれない
trans:
Yep. Our takes about the foot switch
timing might be slightly different.

name: 美琴
text:
タンタンタンタン
タタタタ、タタタッ……

name: にちか
text:
解決です……！
すみません、確認が甘かったです……
trans:
Problem solved...!
I'm sorry, I should've checked better...

name: にちか
text: 明日までに調整してきま────
trans: I'm gonna keep trying it until tomorro—

name: ホームアナウンス
text: まもなく、３番ホームに普通列車────
trans:
An incoming local train will be arriving
at Platform 3 in a moment—

name: にちか
text:
あの、すみません……
美琴さんもこっちのホームでしたっけ？
trans:
Um, sorry that I'm only asking now but...
Is this the platform you're getting on,
Mikoto-san?

name: にちか
text:
い、いえっ
合ってるかもですけど、乗り換えってどこでされますっけ？
trans:
N-No, I mean, it might be the right one,
but, which line do you transfer to again...?

name: 美琴
text: なんとなく、ついてきちゃったの
trans: I just somehow, ended up following you.

name: にちか
trans: You should go to platform 1, Mikoto-san!

name: にちか
text:
……すみません、なんていうかこんな
見送っていただくみたいなこと…………！
trans:
...I'm sorry that you kinda, had to walk so much,
you're even sending me off like this...!

name: 美琴
text: ……乗らないと、閉まるんじゃない？
trans:
...Won't you get left behind
if you don't hop in now?

name: にちか
text:
あっ、はい……！
すみません、ありがとうございます……！
trans:
Ah, right...!
Sorry! Thank you so much...!

name: にちか
text:
……
ど、どうもですー……ありがとうございますー……！
trans:
....ah...! good bye...!
thank you so much for today again......!

name: にちか
trans:
————
(ah, you don't need to wave me goodbye! just go
ahead, please! sorry for the trouble!!)

name: にちか
trans:
————
(wah waah, she's still waving at me...! huh?!
b-byebye to you, too......)

name: にちか
trans:
......
(wait, the train's not leaving at all, like, what?
they're totally blessing me here...)

name: にちか
trans:
————
(waaagh, i'm really so, so, sorry to keep you
waving like that for so lon—)

name: にちか
text:
────────
お疲れ様です……バイバイです……
trans:
————
thank you so much for today...!
byebye......!

name: にちか
trans: I've got a petal on me.

name: 美琴
text: どうして、公園でごはんを食べるの
trans: Why exactly, do we have to eat outside in a park?

name: にちか
text:
タンタンタンタン
タタタタ、タタタッ……
trans:
Tan, tan, tan, tan.
Tatatata, tatata......

name: にちか
text:
タンタンタンタン
タタタタ、タタタッ────
trans:
Tan, tan, tan, tan.
Tatatata, tatata......!
